Title: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the Pro Management Portal (PMP) in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the PMP in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Admins may utilize the Microsoft Teams admin center to circumvent this impact.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the Pro Management Portal (PMP) in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the PMP in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Admins may utilize the Microsoft Teams admin center to circumvent this impact for Android devices.

Current status: We've confirmed that a spike in request traffic following yesterday's outage is causing Windows and Android devices to appear as unmonitored in the PMP. To address the issue, we've scaled out the service, restarted affected pods, and redirected traffic from the Teams client away from PMP and to an alternate infrastructure. We're monitoring service health telemetry to verify that these actions restore normal device monitoring.

Scope of impact: This event may impact any admin attempting to manage Windows and Android devices through the Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A spike in request traffic following yesterday's outage is disrupting device monitoring status in the PMP.

Next update by: Friday, November 13, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
